Construction and Landscape Services in Ocean County and Monmouth County NJ

East Avenue Contracting is a construction and landscape group providing landscape design, outdoor living spaces, turnkey property management, coastal dune management, and seasonal lawn care throughout Ocean County and Monmouth County, New Jersey. We serve Bay Head, Point Pleasant, Mantoloking, Lavallette, Toms River, Brick Township, Spring Lake, Belmar, Long Branch, and surrounding Shore communities. Call (848) 333-6632.

What began as Turf Surfers — built on Bay Head lawns and Mantoloking dunes — has evolved into East Avenue Contracting. A construction and landscape group that designs, builds, and manages outdoor spaces with the care of someone who takes real pride in the result.

We serve homeowners, estate managers, local businesses, and builders across Ocean and Monmouth County. Every project is owner-led and held to one standard — the kind that shows.

What We Do

Designed Around
How You Live

From turnkey property management to landscape design and coastal dune care — every service is shaped by a decade of Shore-side experience and delivered with the attention your property deserves.

01

Landscape Design

Full-scope landscape design and installation for homes and estates across Ocean and Monmouth County. From planting plans to hardscape — conceived as an extension of how you want to live outside.

02

Outdoor Living Spaces

Patios, pergolas, fire features, outdoor kitchens, and lighting — spaces where your property becomes an experience. We coordinate with trusted local trades for plumbing and gas. One point of contact, seamless delivery.

03

Coastal Dune Management

Dune restoration, native beach grass installation, and erosion management for oceanfront and bayfront properties. We protect what makes your land irreplaceable.

04

Seasonal Lawn & Garden Care

Seasonal packages covering spring startup through winter snow and ice removal. Consistent, expert care across every month of the year — so your property is always ready, and always right.

05

Commercial & Business Properties

Landscape management for storefronts, offices, and hospitality venues across Ocean and Monmouth County. First impressions, consistently kept.

06

Turnkey Property Management

Full year-round property care for Shore homeowners who want everything handled. Spring opening, fall closing, furniture setup and shrink-wrap, power washing, landscape care, and optional winter home inspection checks — one team, one call, every season.

✦  We partner with trusted local specialists for plumbing, natural gas, and electrical work — so every detail of your outdoor space is handled by the right hands.

Coastal & Estate Work

Coastal & Estate
Properties

From bayfront homes in Bay Head to estate grounds in Mantoloking, we work on properties where the outdoor space is as considered as everything inside. A decade of Shore-side experience means we know this land — its salt, its seasons, and what it takes to keep it looking its best.

Native plantings — beach grass, bayberry, sea lavender — that belong here and hold the land naturally

Dune care rooted in how this particular stretch of coastline moves, shifts, and recovers

Outdoor spaces designed to feel like extensions of a well-considered home — never an afterthought

Seasonal programs built around how Shore families actually use their properties — and the level of care they expect

Year-Round Programs

Your Property,
Every Season

Spring preparation, summer care, fall closedown, and winter snow and ice removal — handled. Your property is always ready for the next season without you having to think about it.

Spring

Cleanup, aeration, overseeding, bed preparation, and irrigation activation

Summer

Weekly maintenance, fertilization, pest monitoring, and coastal dune care

Autumn

Leaf removal, winterization, bulb planting, and end-of-season bed work

Winter

Ice prevention, snow removal, property monitoring, and storm response

How It Works

Organized. Calm.
Elevated.

I
Consultation

We come to you. A relaxed, no-pressure walkthrough of your property — listening first, advising second. No jargon, no sales pitch.

II
Design & Proposal

A clear, detailed proposal. What we'll do, how it'll look, what it costs. No surprises. You'll know exactly what to expect before anything begins.

III
Crafted Execution

Owner-present from day one. Every detail treated as if it's the most important one on site — because to us, it is.

IV
Ongoing Stewardship

A relationship, not a transaction. Proactive seasonal care, responsive communication, and a team that knows your property as well as you do.
